name: aiPHeed five-trigger food-stress risk forecast (E46 I7, defect-corrected)
status: EXPERIMENTAL - FORECASTING ACCEPTANCE NOT MET; enabled only with AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL=e46

information.rule: only data published before the origin 2026-10-01 (E41/E46 protocols)

indicator.name: Food-Stress Risk Probability (exploratory)
indicator.definition: Probability that the province is in concurrent elevated food stress in the target quarter (target T43): SWS self-rated hunger in Balance Luzon above 11.3% (regional) AND the province's PSA food inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E46 defect-corrected five-trigger component model (I7). Exploratory food-stress outcome; not independently verified household food insecurity.
indicator.horizon: Lead 2: issued 2026-10-01 (latest completed quarter 2026-Q3) for 2027-Q1; experimental (E46 I7)
indicator.source: SWS Balance Luzon hunger; PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; NOAA typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA palay/corn and fisheries production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); province-attributed news; official rice-policy orders (as of announcement)
indicator.caveat: Forecasting acceptance (75% Lead-2 accuracy with balanced discrimination) was not met. Exploratory estimate; not an official classification.

scoreTypes.food_stress_risk_probability: Probability that the province is in concurrent elevated food stress in the target quarter (target T43): SWS self-rated hunger in Balance Luzon above 11.3% (regional) AND the province's PSA food inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E46 defect-corrected five-trigger component model (I7). Exploratory food-stress outcome; not independently verified household food insecurity.

operationalRules.band: Low if P < 0.33; Watch if 0.33 <= P < 0.67; High if P >= 0.67
operationalRules.alert: Alert candidate when the band is High; staged for administrator confirmation.
operationalRules.municipal: No municipal probability; LGU rankings are relative prioritization.

PH040100000.name: Cavite

forecast.explanation: Cavite, 2027-Q1 (forecast issued 2026-10-01): estimated probability of concurrent elevated food stress 6% (Low; decision LOW at p >= 0.5). Regional hunger is forecast at 20.6% (chance above 11.3%: 96%); Cavite's food inflation at 0.8% and food minus headline at -2.5 points (chance its price signal is on: 6%).

PH040100000.fiveTriggerNote: Contributions of each trigger group to the food-inflation, food-minus-headline and hunger forecasts of the served model (model attributions, not proof that an event causes food insecurity). Employment and OFW indicators are national.

market.evidence: food and headline CPI enter the served price component
market.evidenceNote: Food inflation 2.5% in the latest two months vs this province's reference 4.71%; food minus headline -2.1 points.

climate.evidence: typhoons, ENSO, palay/corn shown; used by the five-trigger LightGBM, not by the served model
climate.evidenceNote: 0.0 typhoon(s) within 300 km in 2026-Q3; ENSO El Nino in the previous quarter; palay production -18.2% year on year.

fish_kill.evidenceNote: Fisheries production 8.3% and aquaculture 55.2% year on year (2026-Q2); no official fish-kill event series.

employment.evidenceNote: National unemployment 4.79% (2026-Q2), 0.9 points year on year; national figure, the same for every province.

ofw_remittance.evidenceNote: National cash remittances n/a year on year (latest 2025-Q4); USD/PHP 8.35%; national figure.

climate.source: NOAA IBTrACS and CPC ONI (not PAGASA); PSA palay/corn production

fisheries.source: PSA fisheries production (no BFAR fish-kill event series)

ofwRemittance.source: BSP cash remittances curated in bsp_macro.parquet (national; unverified re-download); ECB USD/PHP

PH040100000.pastForecastsNote: Development backtest of the I7 procedure at each past origin (only information published before that origin; verified by deleting all later data); not forecasts issued live, and the outcomes were examined while the correction was designed.
warnings: FORECASTING ACCEPTANCE NOT MET: I7 reaches 0.800 accuracy on the 35 development rows but detects 4 of 9 HIGH quarters (HIGH recall 0.44); experimental decision support only.
Historical scores are development evidence (outcomes examined while diagnosing the defect); acceptance requires the prospective quarters 2027-Q1..Q4.
SWS hunger is regional; provinces differ through food prices and provincial trigger data.
Employment and OFW evidence are national.
Exploratory food-stress outcome; not verified household food insecurity.
